startMessage:
Hey! My name is Ada Lovelace. I used to be a programmer. The first programmer in the history, in fact.

Now I'm here to help you get around and keep the order in your groups.

I have lots of features, such as greetings, a warning system, a flood control system and even more!

privacyPolicy: Hello! I'm Ada Lovelace, a Telegram bot. I'm here to help, but first, it's important that you know how I handle your data. Data Collection: I only save and maintain public data from users and groups that I'm a part of. This includes messages sent in groups and public profile information. Data Usage: The collected data is used exclusively to manage the groups I am part of. Data Sharing: I do not share your data with third parties. The information collected is restricted to the operation of the bot. Security: I take measures to ensure that your data is secure, protecting it from unauthorized access. Your Rights: You have the right to request the deletion of your data at any time. To do so, just contact me through this channel. If you have any questions about this privacy policy, I am here to help!
